name: Logo Finder
description: Find channel logos in a preferred style from Schedules Direct and apply them after a dry-run report.
author: tylertufano

fields.label: Channel profile
fields.help_text: Only channels in this channel profile are considered.

fields.label: Overrides
fields.help_text: JSON object keyed by channel number: a URL to use, or "keep" to leave the channel alone.

actions.label: Preview
actions.description: Report the proposed logo changes without writing anything.

actions.label: Apply
actions.description: Assign the proposed logos and write the report. Existing logos are never deleted.
